summary: RBB Bancorp filed an 8-K announcing two capital return actions: a board-authorized share repurchase of up to 1 million shares (~$25M at current price, ~6% of outstanding) through June 30, 2028, with open-market/private/buyback-plan mechanics; and a partial redemption of $40M principal of its 4.00% Fixed-to-Floating Subordinated Notes due 2031 at par plus accrued interest (~$40.7M total) on July 1, 2026, leaving $80M outstanding. The repurchase plan has no fixed obligation, while the redemption is mandatory upon notice. Watch for execution pace and subsequent tender/refinancing of remaining sub-debt.
